assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an opaque 3:2 Cyberpunk RED 2045 catalogue cover. Image 1 is exact object identity and palette reference. Image 2 is STYLE ONLY: its variable dark-plum outlines, natural scale, broad clean cel-painted light/shadow planes, minimal surface texture and softer simpler lower-contrast background. Do not copy fantasy subjects or composition. Clear light local colors, coherent directional light. Entire main object with comfortable margins, no cropping. No text, logo, watermark, border, UI, gritty realism, glossy 3D or magical motifs. Scene: The exact ammunition tray with brass cartridges sits on a battered but clean arms-dealer counter, teal latch toward the viewer. Larger industrial storage shapes and warm overhead strip lighting form a softly simplified background. No hands, no weapons, no labels. The tray is the focal object, cartridges fully visible.
